description: Dashboard style gallery: complete, themeable reference dashboards an agent can pick from by style family, use case or mode. Each entry lives in site/dashboards/<id>/ (index.html + style.css + app.js + thumb.jpg). Edit here, then run node scripts/build.mjs and node scripts/dashboards-check.mjs.

style_families.name: Cinematic & atmospheric
style_families.blurb: Dark, moody, scenic backdrops (painted or photographic) with glass panels and one warm accent. For consumer products that should feel like an experience.

style_families.name: Glass & glow
style_families.blurb: Frosted translucent panels over gradients or blurred color fields, soft glows. Modern, techy, premium.

style_families.name: Minimal & airy
style_families.blurb: Lots of white space, hairlines, one accent, quiet type. Calm tools people use all day.

style_families.name: Bento grid
style_families.blurb: Tiles of different sizes in a tight grid, each tile one idea. Great for overviews and product showcases.

style_families.name: Data-dense pro
style_families.blurb: Compact tables, many small charts, tight spacing, monospace numbers. Trading, ops, analytics power users.

style_families.name: Soft & friendly
style_families.blurb: Rounded shapes, pastel fills, playful illustration-free warmth. Health, education, personal apps.

style_families.name: Editorial
style_families.blurb: Big serif headlines, magazine layout, image-led storytelling. Brands, content, luxury.

style_families.name: Bold & graphic
style_families.blurb: High contrast, saturated blocks, heavy type, brutalist or neo-brutalist edges. Creative tools, youth brands.

style_families.name: Dark neon
style_families.blurb: Near-black canvas with vivid neon accents and gradients. Gaming, crypto, music, nightlife.

style_families.name: Tactile & neumorphic
style_families.blurb: Soft extruded surfaces, depth, physical-feeling controls. Smart home, devices, audio.

dashboards.name: Horizon Weather
dashboards.summary: A cinematic weather home: painted sunset landscape behind glass panels, an editorial serif headline, a 7-day forecast strip with a glowing selected day, a smooth gold temperature curve and a mood card.
best_for: Consumer apps where the feeling matters as much as the numbers
Travel, outdoor, hospitality or lifestyle dashboards
Landing-page heroes for a data product
avoid_when: Dense business data (tables, many KPIs): the scenery competes with numbers
Low-end devices that struggle with backdrop blur

layout.structure: Fixed left sidebar (brand, 5-item nav, quote) · top bar (pill search, bell, avatar) · hero (headline left, current conditions right) over a painted scene · 7-day strip · 3 columns: area chart, details list, story card · popular-locations row
layout.responsive: ≤1180px: chart spans full width above details + story · ≤960px: sidebar becomes a top bar, hero stacks · ≤640px: single column, icon-only nav, day strip scrolls horizontally

components: Area chart with range toggle and hover/focus values
Image story card with serif quote
dashboards.signature: Code-drawn sunset landscape (SVG, themed by CSS variables) fading into the dark UI, with a gold glow ring on the selected day.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept screenshot. Brand name, photos and copy were replaced; the landscape is drawn in SVG. The source image is not stored in the repo.

dashboards.name: Pulsar Analytics
dashboards.summary: A dark neon product-analytics overview: glossy metric orbs that switch the main chart, layered violet and mint wave areas over a purple floor glow, a ticked uptime dial and gradient pillar bars.
best_for: Product, web or infrastructure analytics for a technical audience
Wall displays and status pages that are read at a glance
Brands that already live in dark mode
avoid_when: Long tables or text-heavy admin screens: the glow tires the eye
Conservative or regulated brands (banking, legal, healthcare)

layout.structure: Top bar (brand, 4-item nav, pill search, range toggle, bell, avatar) · 3 columns at 1440px: 288px left rail (uptime dial, health donut, hourly bars) · fluid centre (4 metric orbs, wave chart, 3 sparkline tiles) · 304px right rail (channel pillars, top events, regions) · 18px gaps
layout.responsive: ≤1180px: centre column spans full width on top, rails sit side by side below, search hides · ≤960px: nav wraps under the bar, orbs 2×2 · ≤640px: single column, orbs stack, chart 200px tall

components: Metric orbs (toggle buttons that switch the chart)
Two-series wave area chart with hover/focus values
dashboards.signature: Violet and mint wave areas rising out of a blurred purple floor glow, with glossy sphere-like metric buttons above.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept render of a dark analytics board. The render had no readable text, so brand, labels, metrics and all data are invented. Charts, dial and orbs are drawn in SVG and CSS. The source image is not stored in the repo.

dashboards.name: Solstice Energy
dashboards.summary: A cinematic solar-monitoring board: a thick gradient sun-path arc rises over a code-drawn mountain range, with generation and load curves on a teal grid, a readout strip, storage dials and round site thumbnails.
best_for: Energy, solar, climate or outdoor-equipment monitoring
A single hero metric that follows the time of day
Control-room or kiosk screens with a strong visual identity
avoid_when: Many records to scan or edit: the hero scene takes most of the first screen
Brands that need a neutral, corporate look
Data with no natural day cycle or location

layout.structure: Slim top bar (brand, 4-item nav, date, 2 icon buttons) · 12-column grid at 1440px, 18px gaps: 3-column rail (today's total, strings table, self-powered ring) + 9-column hero (sun arc scene, hourly chart, 6-item readout strip) · then 2×2 half-width panels (output bars with range toggle, 4 storage dials, hourly load bars, 4 site thumbnails)
layout.responsive: ≤1180px: hero full width on top, rail becomes a two-column panel below · ≤760px: single column, hero chart 130px, readout strip 3×2, dials and sites 2×2

components: Sun-path arc scene with movable sun
Two-series hourly line chart (pick an hour)
dashboards.signature: A thick yellow-to-orange-to-pink arc tracing the sun's path, cut by faceted orange mountains drawn in SVG; the sun dot moves to the hour you pick.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept render with no readable text. The domain (solar monitoring), brand, labels and all data are invented. The mountain photo-style art and the round thumbnails were replaced with SVG and CSS landscapes themed by variables. The source image is not stored in the repo.
